_doc: Follow-up checks, each observing one library item. access: desk = records, drawings, interviews, archive imagery (no site visit); field = needs site access or samples. The fieldplan stage ranks them by expected information gain against the current evidence.

drawings_vs_built.name: Approved drawings and permit vs storeys built
drawings_vs_built.how: Planning approvals (county or city authority), building regulator registration (NCA Kenya, NBRB Uganda), developer adverts, satellite storey count (earthengine stage)

use_and_plant.name: Use, occupancy and heavy plant at the time
use_and_plant.how: Business permits, tenant interviews, social-media posts

prior_distress.name: Distress reported before the collapse
prior_distress.how: Building regulator or council notices (NCA, NBRB, KCCA), tenant complaints, news archive

l0_alterations.name: Ground-storey alterations before the collapse
l0_alterations.how: Pre-collapse photos and videos (social media, Street View), tenant and worker interviews

pour_log.name: Concreting under way on an upper floor at the time
pour_log.how: Contractor records, worker interviews, ready-mix delivery notes

adjacent_works.name: Excavation or works next to the footprint
adjacent_works.how: Satellite chips from the context stage, neighbour permits, photos

column_sizes.name: Ground-storey column sizes vs storeys
column_sizes.how: Structural drawings if obtainable; otherwise tape survey of stubs on site

concrete_strength.name: Concrete strength of ground-storey members
concrete_strength.how: Cores (BS EN 12504-1) or rebound hammer on surviving members and large debris

rebar_check.name: Bar diameter, mass and tensile properties
rebar_check.how: Caliper and mass per metre on debris bars; tensile tests (EAS 412 as KS/US EAS 412, or BS 4449)

tie_survey.name: Column ties: spacing and hooks
tie_survey.how: Tape survey of exposed column stubs and debris columns

lap_survey.name: Column lap positions and lengths
lap_survey.how: Exposed column stubs and debris columns

ground_check.name: Ground and footing condition
ground_check.how: Trial pits at footings, boreholes, settlement survey of neighbours
